name: Travelling Cloak
description: A heavy wool cloak that keeps wind and rain at bay.

name: Shadow Cloak
description: A dark cloak woven with shadow-silk. Hard to see in dim light.

name: Amethyst Wardancer Cloak
description: A regal cloak of shimmering violet silk. It flows behind the dancer like a trail of shadow and light, granting supernatural grace.

name: Celestial Vindicator Cloak
description: A magnificent cloak of shimmering white silk with silver embroidery. A radiant yellow seal is pinned at the shoulder, guiding the faithful.

name: Ironpeak Bear Cloak
description: A heavy cloak woven from the fur of a dire bear, bound with large iron clasps. Provides warmth and protection.

name: Sylvan Elderwood Cloak
description: A flowing silken cloak interwoven with silver thread and enchanted leaves.

name: Mountain Stalker Heavy Cloak
description: A thick, weather-beaten cloak made from the hide of a crag-cat.

name: Aethelgard Archmage Mantle
description: A long, flowing mantle embroidered with constellation maps.

name: Storm-Reaver Pelt
description: A massive bear pelt bound with iron chains, stinking of sweat and victory.

name: Seraphic Grace Stole
description: A long, narrow stole draped over the shoulders, symbolising life and light.

name: Lizard Scale Cloak
description: A powerful cloak crafted from the iridescent scales of a lizard warrior. It glimmers with an otherworldly light, offering superior protection.
